**Mert Buffet & Döner Kebab in Tirol**

Discover authentic Turkish flavors in the heart of **Tirol**! At **Mert Buffet & Döner Kebab**, we bring the taste of home to **Innsbruck** and beyond. Enjoy fresh **Döner Kebab**, succulent **Adana**, and crispy **Lamb Kebab**, all made with the finest ingredients.

Our generous **Buffet** offers a variety of delicious dishes—from **Manti** and **Börek** to **Sarma** and **Gözleme**. Don’t miss our famous **Künefe** for dessert!

Whether you're craving a quick **Döner** or a hearty meal, **Mert Buffet & Döner Kebab** is your go-to spot in **Tirol**. Come taste the flavors of Turkey today! 🇹🇷✨
